entries.title: Matthew 22:1
segments: ¶And Jesus answered and spoke to them again by parables and said:

entries.title: Matthew 22:2
segments: "The kingdom of heaven is like a certain king who arranged a marriage for his son,

entries.title: Matthew 22:3
segments: "and sent out his servants to call those who were invited to the wedding; and they were not willing to come.

entries.title: Matthew 22:4
segments: "Again, he sent out other servants, saying, 'Tell those who are invited, "See, I have prepared my dinner; my oxen and fatted cattle [are] killed, and all things [are] ready. Come to the wedding."'

entries.title: Matthew 22:5
segments: "But they made light of it and went their ways, one to his own farm, another to his business.

entries.title: Matthew 22:6
segments: "And the rest seized his servants, treated [them] spitefully, and killed [them].

entries.title: Matthew 22:7
segments: "But when the king heard [about it], he was furious. And he sent out his armies, destroyed those murderers, and burned up their city.

entries.title: Matthew 22:8
segments: "Then he said to his servants, 'The wedding is ready, but those who were invited were not worthy.

entries.title: Matthew 22:9
segments: 'Therefore go into the highways, and as many as you find, invite to the wedding.'

entries.title: Matthew 22:10
segments: "So those servants went out into the highways and gathered together all whom they found, both bad and good. And the wedding [hall] was filled with guests.

entries.title: Matthew 22:11
segments: "But when the king came in to see the guests, he saw a man there who did not have on a wedding garment.

entries.title: Matthew 22:12
segments: "So he said to him, 'Friend, how did you come in here without a wedding garment?' And he was speechless.

entries.title: Matthew 22:13
segments: "Then the king said to the servants, 'Bind him hand and foot, take him away, and cast [him] into outer darkness; there will be weeping and gnashing of teeth.'

entries.title: Matthew 22:14
segments: "For many are called, but few [are] chosen."

entries.title: Matthew 22:15
segments: ¶Then the Pharisees went and plotted how they might entangle Him in [His] talk.

entries.title: Matthew 22:16
segments: And they sent to Him their disciples with the Herodians, saying, "Teacher, we know that You are true, and teach the way of God in truth; nor do You care about anyone, for You do not regard the person of men.

entries.title: Matthew 22:17
segments: "Tell us, therefore, what do You think? Is it lawful to pay taxes to Caesar, or not?"

entries.title: Matthew 22:18
segments: But Jesus perceived their wickedness, and said, "Why do you test Me, [you] hypocrites?

entries.title: Matthew 22:19
segments: "Show Me the tax money." So they brought Him a denarius.

entries.title: Matthew 22:20
segments: And He said to them, "Whose image and inscription [is] this?"

entries.title: Matthew 22:21
segments: They said to Him, "Caesar's." And He said to them, "Render therefore to Caesar the things that are Caesar's, and to God the things that are God's."

entries.title: Matthew 22:22
segments: When they had heard [these words], they marveled, and left Him and went their way.

entries.title: Matthew 22:23
segments: ¶The same day the Sadducees, who say there is no resurrection, came to Him and asked Him,

entries.title: Matthew 22:24
segments: saying: "Teacher, Moses said that if a man dies, having no children, his brother shall marry his wife and raise up offspring for his brother.

entries.title: Matthew 22:25
segments: "Now there were with us seven brothers. The first died after he had married, and having no offspring, left his wife to his brother.

entries.title: Matthew 22:26
segments: "Likewise the second also, and the third, even to the seventh.

entries.title: Matthew 22:27
segments: "Last of all the woman died also.

entries.title: Matthew 22:28
segments: "Therefore, in the resurrection, whose wife of the seven will she be? For they all had her."

entries.title: Matthew 22:29
segments: Jesus answered and said to them, "You are mistaken, not knowing the Scriptures nor the power of God.

entries.title: Matthew 22:30
segments: "For in the resurrection they neither marry nor are given in marriage, but are like angels of God in heaven.

entries.title: Matthew 22:31
segments: "But concerning the resurrection of the dead, have you not read what was spoken to you by God, saying,

entries.title: Matthew 22:32
segments: 'I am the God of Abraham, the God of Isaac, and the God of Jacob'? God is not the God of the dead, but of the living."

entries.title: Matthew 22:33
segments: And when the multitudes heard [this], they were astonished at His teaching.

entries.title: Matthew 22:34
segments: ¶But when the Pharisees heard that He had silenced the Sadducees, they gathered together.

entries.title: Matthew 22:35
segments: Then one of them, a lawyer, asked [Him a question], testing Him, and saying,

entries.title: Matthew 22:36
segments: "Teacher, which [is] the great commandment in the law?"

entries.title: Matthew 22:37
segments: Jesus said to him," 'You shall love the LORD your God with all your heart, with all your soul, and with all your mind.'

entries.title: Matthew 22:38
segments: "This is [the] first and great commandment.

entries.title: Matthew 22:39
segments: "And [the] second [is] like it: 'You shall love your neighbor as yourself.'

entries.title: Matthew 22:40
segments: "On these two commandments hang all the Law and the Prophets."

entries.title: Matthew 22:41
segments: ¶While the Pharisees were gathered together, Jesus asked them,

entries.title: Matthew 22:42
segments: saying, "What do you think about the Christ? Whose Son is He?" They said to Him, "[The Son] of David."

entries.title: Matthew 22:43
segments: He said to them, "How then does David in the Spirit call Him 'Lord,' saying:

entries.title: Matthew 22:44
segments: 'The LORD said to my Lord, "Sit at My right hand, Till I make Your enemies Your footstool"'?

entries.title: Matthew 22:45
segments: "If David then calls Him 'Lord,' how is He his Son?"

entries.title: Matthew 22:46
segments: And no one was able to answer Him a word, nor from that day on did anyone dare question Him anymore.
